item.title: Papers with Code Chat Interface Adds Web Search via Multi-Provider Agent Stack
item.summary: Hugging Face engineer Niels Rogge added web search to Papers with Code's upcoming chat interface using a composable agent stack: Hugging Face Inference Providers, Baseten-hosted DeepSeek-V4 Flash, Exa AI Labs' MCP server, and Modal containers — a single-source announcement amplified by AI paper curator AK.
